data.title: Hormel Foods Corporation Announces Increase to Quarterly Dividend Marking 61st Consecutive Year with a Quarterly Increase
data.description:
Hormel Foods Corporation Announces Increase to Quarterly Dividend Marking 61st Consecutive Year with a Quarterly Increase

Hormel Foods Corporation Announces Increase to Quarterly Dividend Marking 61st Consecutive Year with a Quarterly Increase

PR Newswire

AUSTIN, Minn., Nov. 23, 2026

AUSTIN, Minn., Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Hormel Foods Corporation (NYSE: HRL), a Fortune 500 global branded food company, today announced a one percent increase to its quarterly dividend on the common stock, authorized by the Board of Directors at $0.295 per share. The dividend will be paid on February 16, 2027, to stockholders of record at the close of business on January 11, 2027. This increase raises the implied annualized rate to $1.18 per share and marks the Company's 61st consecutive year with a quarterly dividend increase.

The February 16, 2027 payment will be the 394th consecutive quarterly dividend paid by the company. Since becoming a public company in 1928, Hormel Foods Corporation has paid a regular quarterly dividend without interruption.

About Hormel Foods
Hormel Foods Corporation, based in Austin, Minnesota, is a global branded food company with over $12 billion in annual revenue. Its brands include Planters®, Skippy®, SPAM®, Hormel® Natural Choice®, Applegate®, Wholly®, Hormel® Black Label®, Columbus®, Jennie-O® and more than 30 other beloved brands. The Company is a member of the S&P 500 Index and the S&P 500 Dividend Aristocrats, was named one of the best companies to work for by U.S. News & World Report and one of America's most responsible companies by Newsweek, was recognized by TIME magazine as one of the World's Best Companies and has received numerous other awards and accolades for its corporate responsibility and community service efforts. For more information, visit hormelfoods.com.

data.title: Toshiba Launches Isolation Amplifiers That Contribute to Higher Precision and Improved Safety in Industrial Motor Drive Systems
data.description:
Toshiba Launches Isolation Amplifiers That Contribute to Higher Precision and Improved Safety in Industrial Motor Drive Systems

―High-Precision Current Sensing with High SNR―

Toshiba Electronic Devices & Storage Corporation (“Toshiba”) has launched the “DCA121x02 Series” of analog-output[1] isolation amplifiers for motor drive systems used in servo amplifiers, industrial robots, and other industrial equipment. The two products in the series achieve a high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR[2]) of 85dB (typ.). Volume shipments start today.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261123595566/en/

Toshiba: DCA121x02 Series of analog-output isolation amplifiers for motor drive systems.

The series’ products are “DCA121002,” the base model, and “DCA121102,” which incorporates Toshiba’s proprietary overcurrent high-speed feedback function[3]. Customers requiring high-precision current measurement can use either product, while customers with systems that require high-speed overcurrent detection can select DCA121102.

Advances in factory automation and the increasing functionality of industrial robots have created demand for motor drive systems, including servo amplifiers, that combine smoother, higher-precision control with functions that quickly protect power devices and peripheral circuits when an abnormal condition occurs.

Motor current provides important information for motor control and equipment condition monitoring. Current-sensing devices must capture the information, even in noisy environments, and safely transmit it from high-voltage drive circuits to low-voltage control circuits. Doing this successfully requires high noise immunity, high signal accuracy, and electrical isolation. It is also important that any overcurrent signal is quickly transmitted to the control circuits.

DCA121x02 Series uses Toshiba’s proprietary signal-processing technology[4] to achieve a high SNR of 85dB (typ.). This reduces impacts from noise and enables accurate motor-current sensing, contributing to higher-precision motor control. It also provides a minimum common-mode transient immunity (CMTI) of 100kV/μs, supporting signal transmission in environments subject to steep common-mode voltage transients.

In addition to the current-sensing function, DCA121102 incorporates Toshiba’s proprietary overcurrent high-speed feedback function, which quickly detects overcurrent and provides feedback to the control circuits. While the propagation delay during normal operation is 1.6μs (typ.), the device can provide feedback on the abnormal condition to the control circuits within 500ns (typ.)[5] when an overcurrent occurs. Combining high-precision current measurement and high-speed response to abnormal conditions in a single product, DCA121102 reduces the time required for protection circuits to start operating, contributing to improved safety in motor drive systems.

Both products are housed in the SOIC8-W package, which provides a minimum creepage distance of 8mm and a high isolation voltage of 5000Vrms (min). In addition, the use of the widely used SOIC8-W package provides users with greater design flexibility, while also contributing to stable component procurement and business continuity planning (BCP) [6].

Toshiba will continue to expand its lineup of isolation products that contribute to higher-precision current sensing and improved system safety for a broad range of applications, including industrial and energy equipment.

Notes:

[1] A type of isolation amplifier that outputs a differential analog signal corresponding to the input analog signal.

[2] Ratio of the signal component to the noise component (excluding harmonics), defined with VIN=0.5Vp-p and a 1kHz sine wave.

[3] A function (patent pending) that transmits current-sensing signals with high accuracy during normal operation, while detecting abnormal conditions caused by overcurrent faster than through the normal signal path and notifying the control system only when an overcurrent occurs.

[4] Incorporates high-precision A/D converter technology.

[5] Excludes delays associated with processing externally to the IC.

[6] Business Continuity Planning: Maintaining production continuity even if components become unavailable from a single supplier due to disasters or supply disruptions.

data.title: Asian Equities Rebound as Huang Reinstatement Sparks AI-Stock Rally
data.description:
By Ronnie Harui

Asian equities rebounded Tuesday morning after Jensen Huang's return as chief executive of Nvidia sparked a rally in artificial-intelligence stocks.

The U.S. chip maker's board on Monday reinstated Huang less than two weeks after pushing him out over issues including extramarital affairs. The decision followed intense pressure from Silicon Valley, Wall Street investors, and the White House.

"Huang reinstated as CEO triggers a tremendous tech-led 'risk-back-on' rally," said Vishnu Varathan, head of Macro Strategy for APAC at Mizuho Securities (Singapore). "Markets cheered the news of what is perceived to be stability returning to the wider AI sector as Nvidia with Jensen at the helm was deemed to be the requisite connective tissue of the industry."

However, the company and its reinstated leader face a series of investigations by entities ranging from the Securities and Exchange Commission to a committee of the board itself.

Asian equities rebounded from Monday's selloff. South Korea's Kospi climbed 7.1%, with chip-making index heavyweights SK Hynix and Samsung Electronics rising 8.8% and 6.5%, respectively. Kospi futures rose more than 6%, triggering a five-minute trading halt by Korea Exchange.

Japan's Nikkei Stock Average advanced 4.8%. Resonac Holdings, a supplier of front-end and back-end semiconductor packaging materials, surged 16.4%, Advantest, a manufacturer of automatic semiconductor test equipment for semiconductor industry, jumped 15.6%, and Murata Manufacturing, a manufacturer of electronic components, added 14.9%.

Malaysia's FTSE Bursa Malaysia KLCI advanced 1.3% and Singapore's FTSE Straits Times Index gained 1.3%.

"Jensen's return is particularly welcome for Asian technology stocks, many of which suffered collateral damage from Nvidia's leadership crisis," said Charu Chanana, chief investment strategist at Saxo Markets, in an email.

Meanwhile, crude oil futures were mixed as traders parsed ongoing tensions in the Middle East.

The U.S. is investigating Iran's potential involvement in dozens of cyberattacks against energy tankers amid worries that Tehran is widening the war with cyber operations and terror plots against Americans far from the Middle East.

As many as 50 ships carrying oil, liquefied petroleum, chemical products and other explosive substances are believed to have been attacked, the Wall Street Journal reported, citing U.S. officials and others familiar with the matter.

"Iran continues to attack vessels in the Strait of Hormuz, with [President] Trump announcing it has launched more drones and missiles in the last week than at any time of over the year," ANZ Research analysts said in a report. "Despite some improvement in inventories and product availability, the oil market remains under severe strain," the analysts added.

Front-month West Texas Intermediate crude oil futures were little changed at $80.16 a barrel, while front-month Brent crude oil futures edged 0.1% lower to $89.28 a barrel, ICE data showed.

data.title: FondCircle Unveils New Physician-Co-Branded N1 Digital Otoscope at HLTH USA 2026
data.description:
FondCircle Unveils New Physician-Co-Branded N1 Digital Otoscope at HLTH USA 2026

FondCircle Unveils New Physician-Co-Branded N1 Digital Otoscope at HLTH USA 2026

PR Newswire

LAS VEGAS, Nov. 23, 2026

Developed with ENT specialist Dr. John Boone, the smartphone-connected ear camera launches in January 2027 alongside FondCircle's Black Friday event.

LAS VEGAS, Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Connected home health brand FondCircle wrapped up its debut appearance at HLTH USA 2026 (held November 15–18 at The Venetian Expo in Las Vegas) by announcing a long-term strategic partnership with board-certified otolaryngologist Dr. John Boone and unveiling its first physician-co-branded device, the N1 digital otoscope. Scheduled to launch on Amazon and fondcircle.com in January 2027, the N1 brings real-time ear canal visualization directly to consumers' smartphones.

Dr. Boone, who serves as FondCircle's medical director, brings more than a decade of clinical experience treating both adults and children, alongside his background as founder of PrimaryENT in Minnesota and founder and CEO of EUC. Through this multi-year collaboration, Dr. Boone provides clinical insight and physician-informed design input across FondCircle's expanding product roadmap.

"Parents and caregivers often feel anxious when ear discomfort strikes at home, yet they lack simple ways to see what is happening or share clear visuals with a healthcare provider," said Dr. John Boone. "Working with FondCircle on the N1 allowed us to focus on practical, everyday usability—giving families an accessible tool for visual documentation and better-informed conversations with their doctors."

Designed for convenient home observation and record-keeping rather than medical diagnosis, the N1 digital otoscope (model FMC-N1) connects directly to compatible USB-C mobile devices—supporting both iOS (iPhone 15 series and newer) and USB-C Android smartphones—to stream live video inside the FondCircle App. Users can capture high-clarity photos and video clips to track changes over time, assisted by six built-in LEDs with on-device adjustable brightness controls.

Alongside the N1 preview, FondCircle's exhibit offered attendees hands-on demonstrations of its flagship home monitoring lineup, all unified within the FondCircle App so households can track longitudinal trends and share selected readings with family members or caregivers:

  • A2 Upper-Arm Blood Pressure Monitor: Clinically validated for blood pressure measurement during pregnancy and in adults with diabetes through separate accuracy studies meeting ISO 81060-2 standards. Features a 5.7-inch display with a built-in seven-day trend chart and optional spoken readings.
  • A3 Upper-Arm Blood Pressure Monitor: Equipped with TripleCheck technology, which automatically captures three consecutive readings and calculates an average, complete with Bluetooth syncing to the FondCircle App.
  • F3 Body Fat Analyzer: Tracks 15 body composition metrics via the FondCircle App while cycling through seven core readings directly on its onboard color display.
  • D1 Infrared Thermometer: Delivers forehead and ear temperature readings in under one second, featuring a fever-indicating color-coded screen and a silent mode for nighttime checks on sleeping children.

During the conference, FondCircle founder and CEO James Sun also joined attendees on the show floor to share the company's founding vision of making everyday health monitoring less intimidating for modern households.

"Home health devices shouldn't feel cold, complicated, or disconnected from real life," said James Sun, founder and CEO of FondCircle. "Our debut at HLTH USA and our partnership with Dr. Boone reflect our commitment to pairing clinical perspective with intuitive design that empowers families every day."

Holiday Savings Event Underway

As the holiday shopping season kicks off, FondCircle is running its Black Friday Savings Event through November 30, 2026, offering up to 50% off select devices and free U.S. shipping sitewide at fondcircle.com/pages/black-friday and Amazon.

For ongoing updates on the N1 digital otoscope ahead of its January 2027 retail debut, visit fondcircle.com/pages/hlth-2026.

About FondCircle

FondCircle develops connected home health monitoring devices designed to make everyday health tracking simpler and more accessible. Its ecosystem spans blood pressure monitors, body composition scales, infrared thermometers, blood glucose meters, and pulse oximeters, all integrated through the FondCircle App to help users organize readings, monitor trends, and share records with loved ones and caregivers. Learn more at fondcircle.com.

data.title: ICP DAS Turns Sustainability Commitments into Action: Advancing Energy Efficiency, Green Innovation and Responsible Business
data.description:
ICP DAS Turns Sustainability Commitments into Action: Advancing Energy Efficiency, Green Innovation and Responsible Business

ICP DAS Turns Sustainability Commitments into Action: Advancing Energy Efficiency, Green Innovation and Responsible Business

PR Newswire

HSINCHU, Nov. 23, 2026

HSINCHU, Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- As sustainability becomes important to businesses, ICP DAS turns its commitments into action through energy efficiency, green innovation, responsible operations, and technology development.

In its 2025 Sustainability Report, ICP DAS highlights its efforts to integrate sustainability into operations and product development. In 2025, the Company generated NT$1.172 billion in revenue, up 9.44% year over year, while continuing to develop industrial automation and IIoT solutions for energy management, environmental monitoring, and factory safety.

Green innovation remains a focus, with R&D efforts centered on ESG, AIoT, and smart manufacturing. In 2025, ICP DAS developed 113 new products, including solutions for temperature and humidity monitoring, liquid-leak detection, air quality, and electrical distribution panel safety. Its energy-management solutions help businesses collect and analyze energy data to support informed decisions and ESG initiatives.

The Company strengthens its environmental performance through greenhouse gas inventories, energy-saving measures, and green product design. Its product approach considers material selection, manufacturing, product use, and end-of-life management, supported by requirements covering RoHS, REACH, halogen-free materials, and conflict minerals. In 2025, emission intensity decreased by 9.84% compared with 2024, while 100% of reported waste was legally processed or recycled, exceeding the annual target.

Responsible business practices extend across the supply chain and workplace. ICP DAS evaluated 48 new suppliers and conducted annual assessments of 25 suppliers in 2025. The Company reported no major human-rights violations, major occupational accidents, unethical conduct cases, or competition-law violations.

In November 2025, ICP DAS began implementing ISO 27001 and developed procedures to strengthen information security and support governance goals.

Looking ahead, ICP DAS has established greenhouse gas reduction targets of 4% for 2026–2030 and 6% for 2031–2035, using 2024 as the baseline. Plans include improving air-conditioning system efficiency through intelligent monitoring and control.

About ICP DAS

Founded in 1993 and headquartered in Taiwan, ICP DAS is a global leader in industrial automation and IoT solutions. With more than three decades of expertise, the company delivers hardware and software that empower businesses to embrace Industry 4.0 and the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT). By combining R&D capabilities with international market experience, ICP DAS continues to drive innovation that transforms factories, utilities, and infrastructure worldwide.

data.title: Macquarie Led Group to Buy Axiata's International Towers in $1.2 Billion Deal
data.description:
By P.R. Venkat

A Macquarie-led consortium has agreed to acquire Axiata's international telecom tower businesses, valued at about $1.2 billion, expanding the Australian asset manager's Southeast Asian digital infrastructure footprint.

The consortium will buy the tower businesses of Malaysian telecom group Axiata's unit Edotco in the Philippines, Indonesia, Bangladesh, Pakistan and Cambodia, Macquarie said Monday.

Its Macquarie Asia-Pacific Infrastructure Fund 4 will acquire the Philippine business, which has about 3,200 towers, while other consortium members will buy the rest.

"The investment reflects our conviction in the continued growth of digital infrastructure across Southeast Asia," said Verena Lim, Asia chief executive of Macquarie Group and co-head of Asia-Pacific infrastructure at Macquarie Asset Management.

In a regulatory filing, PT Tower Bersama Infrastructure said it agreed to buy all of Edotco's Indonesian business. Bangladesh-focused private equity firm Osiris Group said it would buy a 70% stake in the Bangladesh business and all of the Pakistan business.

Malaysia's OCK Group said in a filing that it agreed to buy the Cambodia business, which operates more than 3,800 telecom towers.

In its home market, Axiata will also sell about 15.645% of Edotco Malaysia to state fund Khazanah Nasional for about 659.4 million ringgit, equivalent to $159.9 million. Following the deal Axiata and Khazanah Nasional will each have a 47.355% stake and joint control of the Malaysian business.

The sales are part of a wider restructuring by Axiata that values Edotco at 11.8 billion ringgit.

Axiata expects gross proceeds of about 2.2 billion ringgit, which will mainly be used to pare down debt. The deals are expected to cut its gearing, a measure of debt against equity, to 0.50 times from 0.71 times.

"Reducing leverage and strengthening our balance sheet will give us greater financial and strategic flexibility," Axiata Chief Executive Nik Rizal Kamil said.

The deals need approval from shareholders and regulators. Macquarie expects its purchase to be completed in 2027.

data.title: I've been married for 58 years. It's 'our' money, not 'his' and 'hers.' Why do so many couples keep their finances separate?
data.description:
By Quentin Fottrell

'My wife stopped working outside the home in 1970'

"We have never worried about each other overspending or incurring debt." (Photo subjects are models.)

Dear Quentin,

As a regular reader of The Moneyist, I am puzzled by letters from married couples that talk about his money and her money, her spending and his saving; he shares but she doesn't, or vice versa; and money issues that seem to portray two people living separate financial lives, not a married couple, not ours, but yours and mine. I don't get it.

To put that in perspective, I am 83 and we have been married for 58 years. My wife stopped working outside the home in 1970. In all those years, every money decision has been a joint one; every dollar has been ours; and bank and investment accounts are joint. We have never worried about each other overspending or incurring debt.

Are we just abnormal, or is it a generational thing?

Happily Married

You can email The Moneyist with any financial and ethical questions at qfottrell@marketwatch.com. The Moneyist regrets he cannot reply to questions individually.

Related: My husband is happily retired at 64 and thinks I should keep working. Is he being fair?

The share of couples that did not have any joint bank accounts rose by more than half over the last 30 years.

Dear Happily,

Yes. That's the short answer. Now for the longer one.

Older couples have joint accounts for a variety of reasons. Among them: Women traditionally were more likely to work as homemakers, and the money earned by the breadwinner was for the whole family; couples 30-plus years ago had bigger families that encouraged pooling of resources; and the longer people stay together, the more incentive they have to trust that they will stay together and plan for their future as a team. Second marriages typically have a higher rate of separate accounts.

I would caution against assuming that all letters to this column reflect definite trends in society. While a larger share of younger couples do have separate accounts, as it happens, the nitpicking, if you want to call it that, can lead to moral and ethical dilemmas, differences in spending and saving, suspicion and financial infidelity. One partner might spend money on a new watch or piece of jewelry without telling their partner, leading to questions about fiscal responsibility.

To put some context to your hunch: The share of couples without joint bank accounts rose by more than half, from 15% in 1996 to roughly 23% three decades later, according to the U.S. Census Bureau. Some of the theories given: Couples now tend to marry later when their finances are already established, making them less likely to merge accounts. In 1996, the median age at first marriage was 24.8 years for women and 27.1 years for men. Today, it's about three years older than that.

Related: 'They hate our generation': My son and daughter-in-law want us to sell our house - and move to Oregon to start a commune

Trust in joint accounts

The more faith you have that your marriage will last - it is a legal partnership - the more sense it makes to have joint accounts. That's the takeaway from this analysis by U.S. News and World Report. "With joint accounts, spending can be easily viewed by both spouses, and that level of openness can be reassuring," it says. Though those with separate accounts also may have open and honest relationships, it may be that the most harmonious relationships tend to lean toward joint accounts."

Family finances are, arguably, easier to manage with joint accounts. "Too many bank accounts can muddy the waters and make it difficult to properly track spending and pinpoint areas where a family's budget could be improved," it adds. "Couples may also want to keep joint accounts because they ensure both spouses can access money at any time. If only one person's name is on an account and that spouse becomes injured or ill, their partner may be unable to pull out money needed for medical expenses."

People getting married today come with a lot more baggage.

People getting married today come with a lot more baggage - student debt, individual mortgages because they may have gotten married later in life and disparate credit scores - so separate accounts can protect the wealthier spouse. In the early days of your marriage, your money management was more tangible and a joint effort: You probably used checkbooks and cash together, drove to the supermarket together, and bought clothes in department stores together (or maybe you waited in the car).

Your wife also stopped working full-time outside the home in 1970, which was four years before the Equal Credit Opportunity Act of 1974 that prevented people from being discriminated against by credit-card companies for their race or color, religion, national origin, marital status, age and, last but not least, gender. Opportunities for women and, by inference, dual-income households increased over the following five decades, even if the gender pay gap proves stubbornly hard to close.

Related: 'It feels like he's quietly building a separate life': My husband inherited $500,000, but he refuses to spend it on our home

Lessons from your parents

Fair enough, but the other part of the story - your story - is not reflected in the research or statistics: luck and good fortune. You married the right woman, and she married the right man. You remained committed to your financial goals and true to your personal commitments. As a result, you divided the responsibility of raising and paying for a family, and paid for it as you went along. You are part of the tail end of the Silent Generation, so you know a thing or two about saving and being thrifty.

You were probably raised by either a member of the Silent Generation or the Greatest Generation. They were given their names for good reason. Members of the Greatest Generation were born roughly between 1901 and 1924. They came of age during the Great Depression and fought in World War II. The Silent Generation, born roughly between 1925 and 1945, grew up with the lessons of the previous generation who worked for everything they earned and reaped the rewards of the postwar boom.

A hybrid model of household management allows couples to have both separate and joint accounts and that extra account, if they can afford it, for "mad money" to be used on frivolous expenses. I hope you don't mind me saying that you may have a slight "success bias" - your marriage lasted the test of time and you achieved a financially solid retirement. Many couples in your generation were not so lucky: They fought, they divorced, and they took what they could get from the marriage.

Everyone's normal looks different, including when it comes to shared finances.

Related: 'He calls my plans a fantasy': My husband says we can't afford a $200,000-a-year retirement. Is he being cheap?

data.title: Platinum Equity Completes Acquisition of EDP
data.description:
Platinum Equity Completes Acquisition of EDP

Platinum Equity Completes Acquisition of EDP

PR Newswire

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 23, 2026

Platinum Equity to Support Continued Investments in Sales, Marketing, Technology and Strategic Acquisitions

LOS ANGELES, Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Platinum Equity has completed the acquisition of EDP, a leading provider of propane distribution and other related services to residential, commercial and agricultural customers across the United States. Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

Headquartered in Chicago, EDP serves more than 200,000 customers through a network of more than 60 locations operating across 24 states. Since its founding, the company has established itself as one of the largest independent propane distributors in the country, growing through a combination of strategic acquisitions and organic expansion while maintaining a strong focus on safety, reliability and customer service.

EDP distributes propane and light fuels and provides other related services to residential homeowners, commercial businesses and agricultural customers through a portfolio of locally-managed operating companies with longstanding positions in their communities.

"EDP is right in our wheelhouse from an investment and operational perspective," said Louis Samson, Co-President of Platinum Equity. "It operates in a stable, resilient market with recurring demand and significant growth potential. We're excited to work with the management team and put our experience and resources behind the business."

Platinum Equity has extensive experience investing in distribution, route-based services and multi-site businesses. The firm believes EDP is well positioned to continue to expand its geographic footprint, deepen customer relationships and capitalize on long-term industry growth opportunities.

"We know this operating model well and believe we can hit the ground running," said David Glatt, Managing Director at Platinum Equity. "The toolkit we've developed is highly applicable here. We know the levers that can drive value and see meaningful opportunities across operations, commercial initiatives and strategic acquisitions."

EDP CEO Kevin Pollack will continue to lead the company.

"We share a clear vision for the business and are excited to begin this next chapter with Platinum Equity," said Pollack. "Their operational capabilities and M&A experience will complement our team as we continue to grow EDP."

Platinum Equity was advised by J.P. Morgan Securities LLC and Baird on the acquisition of EDP. Latham & Watkins LLP served as legal counsel to Platinum Equity.

Financing for the EDP acquisition was arranged by J.P. Morgan Securities LLC, Guggenheim Corporate Funding, LLC, Oaktree and Fifth Third.

About Platinum Equity
Founded in 1995 by Tom Gores, Platinum Equity is a global investment firm with approximately $48 billion of assets under management and a portfolio of approximately 60 operating companies that serve customers around the world. Platinum Equity specializes in mergers, acquisitions and operations – a trademarked strategy it calls M&A&O® – acquiring and operating companies in a broad range of business markets, including manufacturing, distribution, transportation and logistics, equipment rental, metals services, media and entertainment, technology, telecommunications and other industries. Over the past 30 years Platinum Equity has completed more than 550 acquisitions. For more information go to www.platinumequity.com or visit Platinum Equity's newsroom for the latest stories about the firm.

About EDP
Chicago, Illinois-based EDP is a highly reputable, super-regional platform within America's highly stable and resilient propane distribution market – with deep experience in retail and commercial propane sales, operations and finance. The company provides safe, reliable propane service to residential and commercial customers in Arizona, California, Connecticut, Delaware, Florida, Indiana, Kentucky, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Nevada, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Virginia, Washington, West Virginia and Wisconsin. EDP pursues a long-term strategy of purchasing successful operations in propane and other fuels, retaining the brand name, preserving local management while continuing to support local communities.

data.title: Los Angeles Thunder Selects Big Ten Player of the Year Kennedy Martin With No. 1 Overall Pick
data.description:
Los Angeles Thunder Selects Big Ten Player of the Year Kennedy Martin With No. 1 Overall Pick

Thunder’s first draft class features 6-foot-6 Penn State star; selection marks the first-ever use of Major League Volleyball’s “Marquee Player Exception”

The Los Angeles Thunder selected 2026 Big Ten Women’s Volleyball Player of the Year Kennedy Martin with the No. 1 overall pick in Monday’s Major League Volleyball Draft, headlining the franchise’s first-ever draft class as Los Angeles prepares for its inaugural season in January. Martin’s selection is also notable as the first time Major League Volleyball’s “Marquee Player Exception” has been used, allowing the Thunder to secure an elite-level talent as they build a foundation for the program’s launch.

A 6-foot-6 opposite from Penn State, Martin is a three-time AVCA All-American and one of college volleyball’s most accomplished offensive forces. She becomes the franchise’s first-ever first-round selection and an instant focal point for the Thunder’s attack as Southern California fans get their first look at a player with a proven record of producing against top-tier competition.

“Kennedy has shown she can score against some of the best competition in college volleyball,” said Alisha Childress, Head Coach of the Los Angeles Thunder. “Her size, offensive production and ability to deliver in big matches make her an exciting selection for our first draft. We look forward to helping her take the next step and giving our fans the opportunity to follow her journey at the professional level.”

Martin was named Big Ten Player of the Year on November 19 in a vote of the conference’s 18 head coaches, and she earned unanimous All-Big Ten First Team recognition. At the time of the award announcement, she led the conference with 462 kills, averaging 4.86 kills per set, and posted a .351 hitting percentage. She helped Penn State close its regular season with 11 consecutive victories, including six wins over nationally ranked opponents. Among her standout performances were a match at Minnesota where she recorded 34 kills and 12 digs, and a win at Wisconsin where she posted 28 kills and 12 digs.

Originally from Fort Mill, South Carolina, Martin began her collegiate career at Florida before transferring to Penn State. She is the daughter of former NFL wide receiver Ruvell Martin, who played seven NFL seasons, including three with the Green Bay Packers from 2006 through 2008. Martin also becomes the first player to benefit from Major League Volleyball’s “Marquee Player Exception” policy, underscoring both her impact on the sport and the league’s belief in the Thunder’s long-term roster-building vision.

The Thunder had originally secured the No. 2 pick in the first round and the No. 1 pick in the second round during the MLV Draft Lottery held in September. Los Angeles then executed a trade of its second-round selection with the Vegas Thrill to secure the No. 1 pick in this year’s MLV Draft.

The Thunder open their inaugural season on Thursday, January 7, 2027, against the Minnesota Forge at Honda Center in Anaheim. Home matches throughout the season will be played at Honda Center and Crypto.com Arena in downtown Los Angeles.

TICKET AND ON-SALE INFORMATION

Fans can begin securing priority access to the LA Thunder’s inaugural 2027 season through season ticket deposits. Fans can place a deposit online to receive priority access to inaugural season ticket packages and single-match ticket opportunities HERE. Additional opportunities to secure partial-season plans, venue-specific fan experiences, and single-match ticket availability will be offered first to Thunder Insiders. Become an Insider HERE.

ABOUT LOS ANGELES THUNDER

Announced in May 2026, MLV Los Angeles is led by majority owner and founder Dr. Patrick Soon-Shiong and Co-Owner and Managing Partner Ben Priest. The organization is focused on building a lasting platform for the future of women’s professional sports, bringing together elite competition, advanced technology, media innovation, and world-class infrastructure in a way that can redefine the future of professional volleyball. For more information, visit losangelesthunder.com and follow the team on Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube.

ABOUT MAJOR LEAGUE VOLLEYBALL

Major League Volleyball (MLV) is the premier professional volleyball league in the United States, designed to provide the sport and its athletes with the major league platform they deserve. Founded on a player-first philosophy, MLV combines elite competition, significant investment in athlete development, experienced professional sports ownership and a commitment to the long-term growth of volleyball across the country. As the league enters its fourth season in 2027, MLV has expanded to 12 teams from coast-to-coast in some of the top media markets in the nation. It will continue to create top-level, lasting opportunities and memories for players, coaches and local communities while leading the way in solidifying the future of professional volleyball in North America. For more information, visit MLVB.com and follow the league on Instagram, Facebook, X and YouTube.

data.title: MemorialCare Orthopedic & Spine Institute Receives 2025-2026 WebMD Patient Choice Award for Orthopedics in Orange County
data.description:
MemorialCare Orthopedic & Spine Institute Receives 2025-2026 WebMD Patient Choice Award for Orthopedics in Orange County

MemorialCare Orthopedic & Spine Institute Receives 2025-2026 WebMD Patient Choice Award for Orthopedics in Orange County

PR Newswire

FOUNTAIN VALLEY, Calif., Nov. 23, 2026

FOUNTAIN VALLEY, Calif., Nov. 23, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MemorialCare Orthopedic & Spine Institute received the 2025-2026 WebMD Patient Choice Award for Orthopedics in Orange County, recognizing it as most preferred by patients seeking orthopedic care in the region. The award is based on patient survey responses collected through the annual WebMD Choice Awards program.

"Being recognized by Orange County patients as a preferred destination for orthopedic care is an incredible honor because it reflects the trust of the community we are here to serve," said Liz Acord, vice president, clinical institutes, MemorialCare. "Whether patients need treatment for arthritis, a sports injury or complex joint conditions, we leave no stone unturned in determining the right care plan for each patient. We combine that tenacity with leading-edge technology, evidence-based treatments and the personalized care you would expect from an academic institution, but close to home. That is our mission."

The WebMD Patient Choice Award recognizes health systems ranked among the top 30% of patient preferences within their specialty and market, excluding recipients of the Elite Choice Award. Website visitors, newsletter subscribers and social media audiences are asked which health system they believe provides the best overall quality and treatment capabilities in each specialty.

Unlike many health care rankings that rely on clinical performance metrics or complex formulas, the awards focus on patient and provider preferences. The program evaluates health systems across oncology, cardiology and orthopedics.

Patient satisfaction at MemorialCare Orthopedic & Spine Institute is closely tied to clinical outcomes that exceed national benchmarks. An important component of that care is getting patients active almost immediately after surgery, which often results in them being discharged home rather than to a skilled nursing facility to continue recovery. Among hip and knee replacement patients, 91% recover at home rather than in a skilled nursing facility, compared with 66% nationally, and the average hospitalization is 1.95 days, compared with 3.1 days nationally.

Additionally, a focus on precision medicine is paramount at MemorialCare Orthopedic & Spine Institute, which can often mean less pain, scarring or a need for revision surgery down the road. Surgeons use Mako robotic-arm assisted technology, which builds a 3D model of each patient's anatomy to plan and guide implant placement. In spine care, surgeons use advanced navigation, including Stryker Q Guidance with CoPilot, which MemorialCare was the first in California to offer, and ExcelsiusGPS robotic navigation to plan and perform procedures with greater accuracy. MemorialCare Orthopedic & Spine Institute also performed the world's first hip revision using Mako Total Hip 5.0 software.

Learn more at memorialcare.org/ortho.

About MemorialCare 
MemorialCare is a not-for-profit, integrated healthcare system with over 200 care locations, including leading hospitals: Saddleback Medical Center, Orange Coast Medical Center, Long Beach Medical Center, and a full-service children's & women's hospital—Miller Children's & Women's Hospital. MemorialCare's clinical networks include the MemorialCare Orthopedic & Spine Institute, MemorialCare Heart & Vascular Institute, MemorialCare Cancer Institute, MemorialCare Neuroscience Institute and MemorialCare Research Program. MemorialCare operates Select Health Plan and provides primary, urgent, and outpatient care through MemorialCare Medical Group and MemorialCare Independent Physicians (IPA). It also offers the subscription-free "Get Care Now" virtual care suite. National accolades include Healthgrades America's Top 250 Hospital, regional recognition in U.S. News & World Report with "high performing" in 46 clinical categories and received a 4.5-star rating in the AMP Medicare Advantage program. Visit memorialcare.org.

About WebMD Health Corp.
WebMD, an Internet Brands company, is at the heart of the digital health revolution that is transforming the healthcare experience for consumers, patients, health care professionals, employers, health plans, and health systems. Through public and private online portals, mobile platforms, and health-focused publications, WebMD delivers leading-edge content and digital services that enable and improve decision-making, support and motivate health actions, streamline and simplify the health care journey, and improve patient care. The WebMD Health Network includes WebMD Health, Medscape, WebMD Ignite (encompassing Krames, The Wellness Network and Mercury Healthcare), Jobson Healthcare Information, MediQuality, Frontline, Vitals Consumer Services, Aptus Health, PulsePoint, The Wellness Network, SanovaWorks, MNG Health, MedicineNet, eMedicineHealth, RxList, OnHealth, Medscape Education, and other owned WebMD sites.
